documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Un-Audited Financial Results For Quarter Ended 30Th June 2026

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported its highest-ever quarterly sales, EBITDA, PBT, and PAT for Q1 FY27, driven by healthy demand, improved operational efficiencies, and cost optimization. Management highlighted strong growth across standalone and consolidated segments, with standalone sales up 40.41% year-on-year. The company remains focused on leadership through technological advancement and international expansion, while navigating cost headwinds and maintaining a conservative revenue outlook for the year. Menon Bearings reported its highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and net profit for Q1 FY27, driven by strong performance across its bimetal, alkop, and braking systems divisions. Management outlined ongoing capacity expansions, strategic capital investments in sustainability and cost-saving measures, and a focus on growing export markets and high-margin products.

guidance.claim: The management expects the total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: For the Alkop segment, management targets revenue of INR100 crores for the current year and around INR125 crores for next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects export contribution to total revenue to go up to 37% by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting an overall turnover growth rate of 25% year-on-year for the next few years.
guidance.quote: And again, we will be sustaining this because of increase in the overall turnover which we are targeting at a rate of 25% year-on-year for next few years.

guidance.claim: Management estimates reaching INR 500 crores by '28.
guidance.quote: And we will take all-out efforts to see how we can reach INR500 crores by '28.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain EBITDA margins between 20% to 22% during the next two years.
guidance.quote: I again assure you that considering the present situation going forward, we will be able to maintain EBITDA more than 20% and it should be about between 20% to 22% during next two years.

guidance.claim: Management estimates revenues to exceed INR 360 crores for FY27.
guidance.quote: Precisely, what we have estimated is more than INR 360 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that visits to Canada and USA are expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: That is because, more particularly, due to our last month's visit to Canada and USA, is expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to operate within its primary segment of auto components where it is seeing sustained demand.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to operate within our primary segment of auto components where we are seeing sustained demand.

demand_outlook.claim: USA market exports have gone up by almost 50% over last year.
demand_outlook.quote: So far as USA market is concerned, our exports have gone up by almost 50% over last year so far as USA market is concerned and there is a lot of opportunities we are looking for.

demand_outlook.claim: European countries are looking to divert their volumes and businesses from China to India.
demand_outlook.quote: Since European countries are looking to divert their volumes and businesses from China to India and they are tapping our doors and we'll be very happy to see that they come into our fold from the next year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores this financial year for increasing bi-metal capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: If you go through the presentation, Rucheeta, you will come to know that we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company planned a CapEx of around INR4 crores for the Alkop segment alone for the year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: Menon Brakes dynamometer is expected to be commissioned by the end of August.
capex_expansion.quote: And just to give a more deeper explanation, by next month, August end, the machine is supposed to be commissioned at our end.

capex_expansion.claim: Planned capex for Alkop is INR 7 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And for Alkop, it is INR7 crores and brakes, it is INR3 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone bi-metal sales increased year-on-year by 40.41% and EBITDA increased by approximately 60%.
margins_costs.quote: Bi-metal Menon Bearings, during the quarter sales increased to INR67.06 crores from INR47.76 crores as compared to the corresponding quarter of the last year that is year-on-year increase of 40.41% and further increased by about 41%. EBITDA is up by ~60%.

margins_costs.claim: Brakes segment EBITDA margin reached 25% during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.And that is above all other segments.

margins_costs.claim: Prices of consumables such as carbide tools increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated and bi-metal EBITDA margins are around 21% plus.
margins_costs.quote: So, for the bi-metal is concerned the margin, so, EBITDA margins are around 21% plus. Then Alkop, it is almost 21%.

margins_costs.claim: Export margins are always better than aftermarket or OEM.
margins_costs.quote: That is for exports, where margins are always better than aftermarket or OEM.

margins_costs.claim: Tooling costs for manufacturing were previously shown under operating expenses and are now shown under raw material consumption.
margins_costs.quote: Last year the tooling cost so far as tooling manufacturing is concerned was shown under operating expenses. Now, it has been shown in the actually raw material consumption and that's why there is a difference and that note has been already given.

orders_capacity.claim: Bi-metal division capacity utilization is at 85%.
orders_capacity.quote: So currently our utilization is at 85%.

orders_capacity.claim: The new development parts pipeline includes 51 new parts across major customers representing a business value of almost INR 30 crores within this year and next year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our new development parts pipeline is robust with 51 new parts across major customers like John Deere for India domestic and exports as well. Eaton, Taco Prestolite and Mayekawa representing a business value of almost INR 30 crores within this year and next year.

orders_capacity.claim: In the Bi-Metal division, the robust pipeline is more than INR 50 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With this, apart from this, in Bi-Metal division also, we are having a robust pipeline of more than INR 50 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Current order position is more than INR 32 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: You see, our current order position is more than INR32 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded through internal accruals only without fresh loans.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared a dividend of Rs 2 per share having face value of Re 1 each.
capital_allocation.quote: Note: The Board has declared Dividend of Rs. 2 per share having face value of Re. 1 each

capital_allocation.claim: Most of the capex that the company is going to do will be financed with internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: and whatever capex is that we are going to do that most of it will be financed with internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were stuck due to backlogs caused by the Strait of Hormuz and war.
risks_headwinds.quote: But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: The new labour code was introduced by the government and regulations were issued in April '25.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now, as a legal compliance, so the new labour code has been introduced by the government and the regulations have been issued in the month of April '25.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export shipments to African countries through Dubai were halted for three months, affecting business to the extent of almost INR 2 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: So what has happened so far as Dubai is concerned, they export to African countries through Dubai. For last three months, we have -- that export is halted. That has affected to the extent of almost INR2 crores of business that we have lost during last three months.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets Alkop revenue to reach INR100 crores for the current year and around INR125 crores for next year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to target a year-on-year revenue growth rate of 25% for the next few years.
management_commitments.quote: And again, we will be sustaining this because of increase in the overall turnover which we are targeting at a rate of 25% year-on-year for next few years.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to take all-out efforts to reach INR 500 crores by 2028.
management_commitments.quote: And we will take all-out efforts to see how we can reach INR500 crores by '28.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to maintaining EBITDA margins between 20% and 22% during the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: I again assure you that considering the present situation going forward, we will be able to maintain EBITDA more than 20% and it should be about between 20% to 22% during next two years.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to complete the Alkop pipeline of INR 30 crores within two years.
management_commitments.quote: And that all will be productionized in this year as well as some part of it will be in the next year. So overall INR30 crores business pipeline in Alkop is pending and will be completed during these two years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
